Title: Vast Wealth and Leather Jacket/Baseball Bat/etc.

Messages.Author: Satrapa
Messages.Body:
If minion equip with card like L.J. or B.B. that have effect when
action to equip with it is successful does he benefit from this
effect?
Does answer for this question is the same for Anonymous Freight and
Jack of both Sides?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Satrapa wrote:
> If minion equip with card like L.J. or B.B. that have effect when
> action to equip with it is successful does he benefit from this
> effect?

Yes. It is an action to equip the Leather Jacket (or Baseball Bat).

> Does answer for this question is the same for Anonymous Freight and
> Jack of both Sides?

Yes. They're both equip actions (when used to get equipment).
